Out of Time

You come across a strange town on your travels where the clocks don’t run.

Curious, you soon realize that you’ve been tasked with piecing this puzzle together before returning.

Can you untangle time and make your way home?

———

Playtime: 3-4 hours

Length: 23,000 words, 750 illustrations, 6 endings

CW: Occasional alcohol and tobacco imagery, mild injury, subtle references to violence
